about_short_description.short_description: Laudspeaker is a free and open source replacement for customer io, braze, and iterable.

product.name: Laudspeaker Customer Engagement Platform
product.description: An open source platform for sending push notifications, email, SMS, and other messages to users, enabling segmentation, retargeting, and personalized messaging across multiple channels.

product.name: Laudspeaker Mobile SDKs
product.description: Software development kits for iOS and Android that enable apps to send and receive push notifications, track user events, and interact with Laudspeaker journeys.

product.name: Journey Builder
product.description: A visual tool to design and automate multi-step, omnichannel customer messaging flows with branching logic and personalization.

product.name: Segment Builder
product.description: A tool to create dynamic user segments based on real-time attributes, events, and behaviors for targeted messaging.

product.name: Template Builder
product.description: A no-code message template creator for designing personalized push, email, SMS, and in-app messages.
